metadata.title: The Substitute Bride Remembers Everything
metadata.subtitle: They forced me to marry the comatose heir so my half-sister could elope—then murdered me when he woke up rich. This time, I wake HIM up first.

nodes.text: 10:12 PM · Silk veil still pinned to your hair. You’re standing beside Adrian Cross’s private ICU bed—on the exact wedding night your family sold you.
Good luck playing nurse to a vegetable, Camille! My boyfriend and I just landed in Bali!
Enjoy Bali, Bianca. You have no idea he’s only faking the coma.
Mom, make sure the Cross estate wires the $3M dowry to MY account by morning.

nodes.transcript: [low whisper on hallway cam] "Miss Camille, someone tampered with Mr. Cross’s IV drip 20 minutes ago. Don’t touch the blue bag!"

nodes.prompt: You spot the air-bubble valve on Adrian’s IV line—and his eyes flicker open under the lashes:

options.label: Clamp the sabotaged IV line immediately
options.player_reply_text: Stop pretending, Adrian Cross. I just saved your life—wake up.

options.label: Swap the drip & whisper his assassin’s name

nodes.text: You clamp the line. Adrian’s cold fingers suddenly catch your wrist—his dark eyes wide awake.
Who are you? And how did you spot a micro-valve in the dark?
You whisper his cousin’s name right beside his ear. Adrian’s pulse monitor spikes as he sits up cleanly.
Nobody knows my cousin hired the nurse... Who sent you, bride?
The "comatose" billionaire swings his legs off the bed, locking the suite door from inside.
If you’re not Bianca’s spy, tell me why you’re wearing her wedding ring tonight.

nodes.headline: The Sleeping Lion Wakes
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Wrong Bride’s Ring — In your first life, Bianca returned the day Adrian recovered and claimed SHE had nursed him—then pushed you down the stairwell..

nodes.text: 10:25 PM · In your first life, Bianca returned the day Adrian recovered and claimed SHE had nursed him—then pushed you down the stairwell.
Your family sent the wrong daughter to my bedside—and you knew the exact toxin in that IV bag.
I’m Camille, the legal wife on the marriage certificate. Keep me alive and I’ll expose your uncle’s coup.
Wait—why did my mom say the nurse failed?! Is Adrian still unconscious?!

nodes.transcript: [cool amused tone] "Interesting deal. Let’s test your honesty—whose initials are inside the ring your sister threw away?"

nodes.caption: Close-up of the Cross family wedding band — engraved inside with Adrian’s mother’s secret crest.

nodes.prompt: Adrian holds out his hand to inspect the ring on your finger:

options.label: Name his mother’s crest before he looks
options.player_reply_text: "E.C. 1998." Bianca called it ugly and tossed it at me in the car.

options.label: Offer a 90-day alliance contract right now

nodes.text: Adrian’s guarded expression melts into genuine shock—only two people alive knew that engraving.
You really aren’t working for them. Stay by my side, Camille.
You draft a 90-day mutual-protection pact on his tablet—you expose his boardroom enemies, he crushes your toxic family.
Deal signed. Let’s ruin our families together, Mrs. Cross.
Outside the door, footsteps stop abruptly—Adrian’s cousin just came to check if the poisoned IV worked.
Alert! Cousin Marcus just swiped into the ICU wing with two private guards!

nodes.headline: Play Dead One More Time
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Midnight Visitor — Adrian slips back under the crisp white sheets, feigning a flat gaze while your phone records from the nightstand..

nodes.text: 10:40 PM · Adrian slips back under the crisp white sheets, feigning a flat gaze while your phone records from the nightstand.
I’m stalling Marcus at the scrub sink—30 seconds until he enters the room!
Let him come in. He’s about to confess right into my microphone.
Tell Marcus if Adrian dies tonight, our family still keeps the $3M dowry!

nodes.transcript: [barely moving lips] "Act terrified, Camille. Let him brag—he always brags when he thinks he’s won."

nodes.prompt: Cousin Marcus enters, smirking at the untouched IV bag:

options.label: Pretend to cry & ask why the drip stopped
options.player_reply_text: Please help—the nurse ran out and his monitor is beeping weirdly!

options.label: Trigger the hidden hallway security livestream

nodes.text: Marcus laughs softly: "Relax, bride. By dawn Adrian’s heart stops and I inherit Cross Holdings."
Got every word on stereo audio. Ready to wake up now?
You stream Marcus’s gloating straight to the Cross family board group chat—forty executives watching live.
My uncle’s phone is already ringing off the hook—Marcus has no clue!
Marcus reaches to unclamp the poisoned IV himself—and Adrian’s hand snaps around his throat.
Miss me, Marcus? Say hello to the board of directors on speakerphone.

nodes.headline: Caught Red-Handed
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Bali Return — Next morning.

nodes.text: 11:00 AM · Next morning. Headlines explode: "Billionaire Heir Adrian Cross Awakens Healthy!" Bianca buys the first flight back from Bali.
Camille, pack your cheap suitcase and get out of Cross Manor! I’m the REAL fiancée—you were just keeping the bed warm!
Check the civil registry, Bianca. My name is on the marriage license, not yours.
Mom, tell Adrian Camille forged my signature and stole my wedding gown!

nodes.transcript: [dry chuckle] "Your sister is screaming at my front gate with three suitcases. Should I turn on the lawn sprinklers?"

nodes.prompt: Bianca storms into the foyer demanding Adrian kick you out:

options.label: Play her Bali text calling Adrian a vegetable
options.player_reply_text: Adrian, want to read what Bianca texted me while you were in the ICU?

options.label: Bill her family $3M for breach of dowry

nodes.text: Adrian reads Bianca’s "good luck nursing a vegetable" text out loud in front of the whole household staff.
That—that was a joke! My phone was hacked on the plane!!
Adrian’s lawyer hands Bianca’s mother an immediate $3M fraud-clawback demand—freezing their family boutique.
Three million?! You can’t freeze our accounts—we’re in-laws!!
Adrian wraps his suit jacket around your shoulders in full view of the driveway cameras.
Only one woman saved my life last night—and she’s the only Mrs. Cross. Security, escort the trespassers out.

nodes.headline: Thrown Out The Gate
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Charity Banquet Trap — Bianca refuses to quit.

nodes.text: 7:20 PM · Bianca refuses to quit. She sneaks into the Cross Foundation gala disguised as a VIP guest—planning to spill red wine and blame you.
Heads up, Camille—Bianca bribed a waiter for a kitchen pass and is heading toward the balcony.
In my first life, she pushed me off that exact marble balcony. Not tonight.
Once she’s humiliated in front of the press, Adrian will divorce her by Monday!

nodes.transcript: [warm protective tone] "Don’t step onto the balcony alone. I’ve got two bodyguards waiting behind the velvet curtains."

nodes.text: [low, steady whisper] "I’m watching Bianca from the upper gallery. She just slipped behind the AV booth with a flash drive—want me to cut the feed or let her hang herself live?"
Watching Bianca from the upper gallery—she just slipped into the AV booth with a flash drive. Your call.

nodes.prompt: Bianca strides toward you with a full decanter of merlot:

options.label: Step aside cleanly as she lunges forward
options.player_reply_text: Careful, Bianca—the marble floor gets slippery when you’re desperate.

options.label: Let the ballroom spotlight hit her mid-lunge

nodes.text: Bianca trips over her own hem, soaking herself head-to-toe in crimson wine in front of the orchestra.
She tripped me!! Someone arrest her!!
The spotlight snaps on as the giant screen replays her bribing the waiter two minutes earlier.
Turn off the screen!! That’s edited!!
Society columnists snap photos non-stop as security escorts the wine-soaked impostor out.
Wait—your stepmother just dropped a rumor to the press that you aren’t even your father’s biological daughter.

nodes.headline: Bloodline Lies
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Birth Secret — A memory clicks: your stepmother swapped hospital tags 24 years ago—YOUR mother was the real heiress, not Bianca’s!.

nodes.text: 9:15 PM · A memory clicks: your stepmother swapped hospital tags 24 years ago—YOUR mother was the real heiress, not Bianca’s!
I ran the discreet cheek swab you gave me against the late Madame Lin’s archived sample at St. Jude Hospital.
Tell me the truth, Dr. Sato. Am I her daughter?
Mom, burn the old St. Jude hospital bracelet! If Camille finds out who her real mother was, we’re finished!

nodes.transcript: [stunned whisper] "Camille... Madame Lin was my mother’s best friend. The original engagement was ALWAYS meant for YOU!"

nodes.prompt: Your stepmother texts threatening a press conference at 10 AM to disown you:

options.label: Tell her to invite every news channel in town
options.player_reply_text: Please do hold that press conference. I have a DNA surprise for everyone.

options.label: Have Adrian’s lawyers subpoena the hospital log

nodes.text: Your stepmother takes the bait—booking the Grand Hotel press room for 10 AM sharp.
The certified DNA lab report will be sealed and in your hand by 9 AM!
Adrian’s legal team seizes the 2002 maternity ward archive before your stepmother can shred it.
We found the retired midwife too—she’s willing to testify!
You look at Adrian’s gentle smile across the study. The substitute bride was the true bride all along.
Tomorrow morning, we give your real mother her name back—and take every cent they stole from you.

nodes.headline: The True Heiress Rises
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The 99.99% Bombshell — Grand Hotel Press Room.

nodes.text: 10:05 AM · Grand Hotel Press Room. Your stepmother weeps for 30 cameras, claiming you’re a greedy orphan they pitied.
Look at the livestream numbers—80,000 viewers! Enjoy being canceled forever, Camille!
Open the doors, Dr. Sato. Let’s show all 80,000 people the real DNA report.
Wait—why is Dr. Sato walking in with the St. Jude hospital director?!

nodes.transcript: [amplified on stage mic] "Certified lab result: Camille is a 99.99% maternal match to the late heiress Lin. Bianca is NOT her daughter."

nodes.caption: Certified St. Jude Genetics Lab Report — 99.99% maternal match proving Camille is the true Lin heiress.

nodes.prompt: Your stepmother shrieks and lunges to tear the report from the podium:

options.label: Hold up the 2002 midwife affidavit too
options.player_reply_text: You swapped our cribs to steal my mother’s $40M trust. Police are outside.

options.label: Freeze her family’s Lin-Trust stipend live

nodes.text: Bianca collapses onto a folding chair, realizing her entire luxury lifestyle belonged to you.
No!! I’m the heiress—Mom, tell them the lab is lying!!
Adrian’s legal team serves the trust-reversion order on live television—evicting Bianca’s family from the Lin villa by sundown.
We have nowhere to go!! You can’t take our house!!
Uniformed officers step into the press room to arrest your stepmother for infant-swap fraud and trust embezzlement.
That was the cleanest takedown I’ve ever seen, Camille. One last problem left: Marcus’s trial.

nodes.headline: The Last Conspiracy
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Hospital Bribe — Marcus tries to escape custody by threatening the nurse who poisoned Adrian’s IV—your star witness..

nodes.text: 8:45 PM · Marcus tries to escape custody by threatening the nurse who poisoned Adrian’s IV—your star witness.
Camille, the nurse just texted me from the rain-soaked parking garage—Marcus’s thugs followed her car!
Lock down Garage Level B2 and send Adrian’s security team right now!
Marcus promised to pay my legal fees if I tell the police Adrian faked the whole thing!

nodes.transcript: [engine revving] "We’re two blocks from the garage—police patrol is right behind my SUV. Tell the nurse to stay inside her locked car!"

nodes.prompt: Two dark sedans box in the nurse’s compact car in Garage B2:

options.label: Trigger the garage fire-shutter lockdown
options.player_reply_text: Nobody leaves B2 until the police van arrives. Stay put, nurse!

options.label: Sound the alarm & drop the exit bollards

nodes.text: Heavy steel shutters slam down across both ramps, trapping Marcus’s hired men cleanly.
Police just cuffed all three men! The nurse is completely unharmed!
The hydraulic exit bollards rise under the lead sedan’s bumper, immobilizing them right as sirens flood the garage.
They even had Marcus’s cash envelope on the dashboard—case closed!
With witness intimidation added to attempted murder, Marcus’s defense collapses completely.
Every snake in both our families is finally behind steel bars, Camille.

nodes.headline: Out Of The Shadows
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Ninety Days Later — The 90-day alliance contract expires tonight.

nodes.text: 6:30 PM · The 90-day alliance contract expires tonight. You slide the signed paper across the candlelit dining table—unsure what Adrian will say.
You remembered the exact date our truce ends. Ready to collect your half of the deal and walk away?
A deal is a deal, Mr. Cross. You have your company, and I have my mother’s name back.
Tell the jeweler to engrave her real name inside the new ring before 7 PM.

nodes.transcript: [teasing chuckle] "Don’t let him act cool, Camille—he spent three weeks designing a real wedding ceremony for you."

nodes.prompt: Adrian tears the 90-day contract cleanly in half and pulls out a velvet box:

options.label: Smile & ask if this marriage is for real
options.player_reply_text: No fake coma, no substitute bride—just us?

options.label: Put the new ring on him first to claim him

nodes.text: Adrian drops to one knee beside the terrace window, his dark eyes soft for the first time.
One hundred percent real, Camille. Marry me as yourself.
You slip the matching band onto his finger before he finishes his speech—making the billionaire blush.
Fair enough—I’m officially yours, Mrs. Cross.
Fireworks bloom over the harbor outside Cross Manor—lighting up a future nobody can ever steal again.
Ready for a real honeymoon—somewhere far better than Bali?

nodes.headline: A Real Beginning
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The True Bride — Sunlight pours into the glass conservatory.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Sunlight pours into the glass conservatory. This time, the veil is yours, the name is yours, and the man waiting at the altar is wide awake.
No poisoned IVs, no half-sisters, no schemes—just my favorite woman walking down the aisle.
Worth waking up twice for, wouldn’t you say?
I’m sorry I ever called you a substitute, Camille.

nodes.transcript: [cheering with guests] "To the bride who literally brought the groom back from the dead!"

nodes.prompt: Adrian holds out his hand under the white roses:

options.label: Take his hand & say "I do" for real
options.player_reply_text: I do, Adrian—this lifetime and every one after.

options.label: Kiss him before the officiant finishes

nodes.text: Cheers erupt as you place your hand in his—closing the darkest chapter of your life forever.
Forever starts right now, Camille.
You pull him in by his silk tie, drawing a roar of laughter and applause from three hundred guests.
Still impatient—and I wouldn’t change a thing about you!
White petals drift over the glass roof as your second life blooms into everything you deserved.
They thought they threw me away as a substitute. Instead, they handed me my destiny.

nodes.headline: No Substitute For Love · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Act 2 begins: At your wedding reception, a black-ribbon envelope arrives—revealing the 24-year-old hospital swap was only half the plot.

nodes.text: 08:00 PM · Wedding Reception. Fairy lights glow over the champagne tower when a waiter places a velvet-black envelope beside your bridal bouquet.
Adrian, look inside this envelope—it’s a faded photo of my biological mother standing in front of Cross Holdings HQ!
Wait... read the back of the photograph. "The hospital swap 24 years ago wasn’t the only theft. Ask Uncle Victor who really co-founded Cross Holdings."
Emergency, both of you! The detention center just called—Bianca is begging to speak to Camille on a monitored line. Someone threatened her life inside!

nodes.prompt: Bianca betrayed you in two lifetimes—yet she’s terrified tonight:

options.label: Accept Bianca’s detention call
options.player_reply_text: Patch Bianca through—if she’s scared, it’s real.

options.label: Have Adrian trace who delivered the envelope
options.player_reply_text: Check ballroom CCTV for that waiter first!

nodes.text: Connecting the detention center line now—brace yourself, she sounds completely shaken.
Security pulled the tape—that waiter stepped straight out of my Uncle Victor’s black town car!
My Uncle Victor has been acting Chairman while I was in the coma... if your mother co-founded Cross Holdings, he stole her shares too!
My phone is ringing from the detention center. Let’s hear what Bianca knows.

nodes.headline: Bianca’s Prison Warning
nodes.teaser_text: Bianca calls in tears—confessing the secret key your biological mother hid before she disappeared.

nodes.text: 08:08 PM · You step onto the quiet marble balcony away from the reception music as the detention line rings.

nodes.transcript: [sobbing, whispering fast] "Camille, I swear I didn’t send that envelope! A guard slipped me a note from Victor Cross—he’s hunting for your mother’s Bank Box #108 key!"

nodes.text: Why would Adrian’s uncle want my mother’s bank box? What’s inside Box #108?!

nodes.prompt: Bianca’s call timer has only twenty seconds left before cutoff:

options.label: Ask where the key to Box #108 is hidden
options.player_reply_text: Tell me where my mother’s key is—now!

options.label: Promise police protection if she tells all
options.player_reply_text: Tell the truth and Adrian will put you in protective custody.

nodes.text: My mom sewed it inside the velvet lining of your mother’s old jewelry box—the one I threw in the attic! Please hurry before Victor’s men break in!
Thank you, sis... The key is sewn inside your mother’s velvet jewelry box—and Victor wasn’t just after shares, HE paid for the toxin in Adrian’s IV!
I heard every word on speaker. My father’s private attorney holds the mirror-trust for Bank Box #108—I’m calling him to open the vault tonight!
Even in my first life, I never knew Uncle Victor was the real puppet master behind Adrian’s coma...

nodes.headline: The Golden Share
nodes.teaser_text: Bank Box #108 opens—revealing your mother’s 40% founding veto over the entire Cross Holdings empire.

nodes.text: 09:30 PM · Private Trust Vault. Still wearing your ivory wedding gown beneath Adrian’s tuxedo coat, you unlock Box #108.

nodes.caption: Founding Charter of Cross Holdings — grants your biological mother and her sole heir a permanent 40% Golden-Share Veto over the Board.

nodes.text: No wonder my father insisted I marry your family’s true heiress—he wanted to reunite both founding halves and lock Uncle Victor out forever!
And look at the velvet pouch under the charter—my mother’s platinum signet ring! It has the exact twin crest to your wedding band.

nodes.prompt: Dr. Kenji texts urgently from the hospital toxicology lab:

options.label: Ask Dr. Kenji what he found in the lab
options.player_reply_text: Kenji, what did the re-test show?

options.label: Lock the charter in Adrian’s biometric safe
options.player_reply_text: Secure this charter first—Victor will kill for it.

nodes.text: I re-ran the mass spectrometer on Adrian’s original IV bag! The neuro-toxin wasn’t street poison—it’s a patented compound synthesized ONLY by Victor Cross’s biotech subsidiary!
You seal the charter inside Adrian’s encrypted vault just as Dr. Kenji’s toxicology match pings onto both your phones.
Sending the certified lab comparison right now—and get out of the city tonight! Victor’s security chief just asked the reception desk which road you’re taking to your honeymoon villa!
Too late—we’re already on the coastal cliff highway, and it’s pouring rain.

nodes.headline: The Patented Toxin
nodes.teaser_text: Dr. Kenji’s lab report ties Uncle Victor directly to Adrian’s coma—just as your car enters the rain-slicked cliff highway.

nodes.text: 10:15 PM · Coastal Cliff Highway. Rain slams the windshield while headlights flash far behind you in the rearview mirror.

nodes.caption: Certified Lab Match 99.98% — IV neuro-toxin batch #VC-09 matches Victor Cross’s private biotech lab, plus confirmed maternal lineage.

nodes.text: Camille, buckle tight! My brake pedal just went completely soft—someone cut our hydraulic line at the reception valet!
Shift down to low gear and scrape the guardrail on the mountain side—NOT the cliff side!

nodes.prompt: Sparks shower the rainy highway as the hairpin cliff curve rushes toward you:

options.label: Pull the emergency handbrake with Adrian
options.player_reply_text: Hold the wheel—I’ve got the handbrake!

options.label: Upload the lab report to police mid-skid
options.player_reply_text: Uploading everything to police so Victor can’t win!

nodes.text: Steel screeches against the mountain barrier—the sedan spins twice and slams to a halt three feet from the sheer ocean drop!
Evidence sent to Police Major Crimes just as Adrian wrestles the sedan safely into the emergency gravel turnout!
Are you hurt?! Talk to me, Camille—oh thank God you’re breathing!
I’m okay—wait, your phone is ringing on the dashboard. It’s Uncle Victor!

nodes.headline: The Cliffside Ambush
nodes.teaser_text: Uncle Victor calls expecting silence from the bottom of the cliff—and gets a shock he will never forget.

nodes.text: 10:21 PM · Steam hisses from the wrecked hood as you and Adrian scramble into the coastal pine trees—just as Victor’s call rings.

nodes.transcript: [Victor’s cold voice over speaker] "Well, well... still breathing, nephew? You survived the coma once. Let’s see if your little substitute bride can save you at tomorrow’s board vote."

nodes.text: Wait—he doesn’t know we survived unscathed! Dr. Kenji, can you leak a fake ER bulletin saying Adrian slipped BACK into a coma from the crash?!

nodes.prompt: If Victor thinks Adrian is back in a coma, he’ll walk straight into a trap:

options.label: Spring the fake-coma trap tonight
options.player_reply_text: Let him think he won—then catch him stealing the vault!

options.label: Plant hidden cams in the HQ share vault
options.player_reply_text: Kenji, leak the report; Adrian, arm the HQ vault cam!

nodes.text: Brilliant! I’m sending an unmarked rescue van to pick you two up and posting a fake ICU critical-alert right now!
Silent motion cameras in the Cross Holdings vault are LIVE on my phone! Tonight we catch Uncle Victor red-handed.
Dr. Kenji’s van is here. Once we’re safe at the harbor house, there’s something I’ve been hiding from you since the night I woke up.
What secret, Adrian? Tell me.

nodes.headline: Act 3 · The Second Timeline
nodes.teaser_text: At the harbor safehouse, Adrian reveals a breathtaking truth: you weren’t the only one who remembered the first lifetime.

nodes.text: 11:45 PM · Harbor Safehouse. Rain taps softly on the glass as Adrian wraps a warm wool blanket around your shoulders.
Camille, do you ever wonder why I woke up the exact second you touched my hand on our wedding night?

nodes.transcript: [voice thick with emotion] "In my coma, I dreamed an entire lifetime where I woke up too late—and found you at the bottom of the hospital stairwell. I swore I’d wake up first this time."

nodes.text: You remembered too?! All this time, I thought I was fighting fate completely alone...

nodes.prompt: Tears spill down your cheeks as Adrian pulls you into his arms:

options.label: Hold him tight & whisper "Never again"
options.player_reply_text: Never again, Adrian. This lifetime is ours.

options.label: Promise to crush Victor together tomorrow
options.player_reply_text: Two lifetimes of debt—Victor pays tomorrow at 10 AM.

nodes.text: Never again. I didn’t wake up from two lifetimes just to lose you to my uncle.
Wait—speaking of Uncle Victor, look at my screen! The motion alarm inside Cross Holdings HQ just went off!
01:12 AM · HQ Vault Camera Alert: Two figures just unlocked the Chairman’s private archive after seeing the fake ICU report.
He took the bait! Recording everything in 4K right now.

nodes.headline: Caught In The Vault
nodes.teaser_text: Thinking Adrian is back in a coma, Uncle Victor sneaks into the HQ vault to forge the transfer—straight into your camera trap.

nodes.text: 01:15 AM · Live security feed streams straight from Cross Holdings HQ onto your tablet at the harbor safehouse.

nodes.caption: Vault CCTV 01:14 — Victor Cross and his accomplice swapping the original board ledger with a forged proxy transfer.

nodes.text: Even better: the police just detained the hitman who cut your brake line at the hotel valet—and he named Victor Cross on video!
Good luck tomorrow, sis. Finish him for both of our mothers.

nodes.prompt: Victor scheduled an emergency 10:00 AM boardroom coup to strip Adrian’s title:

options.label: Let him start the vote before walking in
options.player_reply_text: Let him announce his fake victory—then we open the doors.

options.label: Coordinate police arrival for 10:05 AM
options.player_reply_text: Time the police raid for five minutes after we speak.

nodes.text: Oh, I like your style, Mrs. Cross. Maximum drama, zero escape.
Chief of Economic & Major Crimes confirmed: squad will hold in the lobby until your signal at 10:05 AM!
I’m wearing my mother’s platinum signet ring tomorrow. It’s time the Cross board met its true co-founder’s daughter.
Get some rest, my queen. Tomorrow we end the curse of both lifetimes.

nodes.headline: 10:00 AM Showdown
nodes.teaser_text: Uncle Victor bangs the gavel to claim Cross Holdings—right as the oak boardroom doors swing wide open.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Cross Holdings HQ, 50th Floor. Bright morning light fills the boardroom as Uncle Victor reads a fake medical notice claiming Adrian is incapacitated.
[stepping through the double doors beside you] Sorry to interrupt your eulogy, Uncle—did I miss the vote?

nodes.caption: Mother’s Platinum Signet Ring — placed directly on the boardroom table beside the notarized 40% Golden-Share Charter.

nodes.text: And as sole heir to the 40% Founding Golden Share, I formally veto Victor Cross’s motion—and call for his immediate removal for attempted murder.

nodes.prompt: Victor slams the table screaming that your charter is fake:

options.label: Play the 01:14 AM vault CCTV on screen
options.player_reply_text: Explain what you were doing in the vault at 1:14 AM!

options.label: Display Dr. Kenji’s 99.98% toxin match
options.player_reply_text: Explain why your biotech toxin was in Adrian’s IV!

nodes.text: The 4K vault footage fills the wall screen—twelve senior directors gasp and slide their chairs away from Victor in horror!
Dr. Kenji’s certified toxin batch #VC-09 report flashes across every director’s tablet—shattering Victor’s last shred of authority!
Look at your phone—the Police Chief is calling to confirm officers are stepping off the 50th-floor elevator right now!
Time’s up, Uncle.

nodes.headline: The Handcuffs Click
nodes.teaser_text: Police march into the 50th-floor boardroom to arrest Victor Cross—and the board votes unanimously on a new era.

nodes.text: 10:05 AM · Boardroom 50F. Uniformed officers step calmly into the sunlit room just as your phone rings with official confirmation.

nodes.transcript: [relieved, smiling] "Confirmed! The hitman’s full confession is signed, and the arrest warrant for Victor Cross is live—zero chance of bail!"

nodes.text: They just escorted Uncle Victor out in handcuffs. Not a single director looked back at him.

nodes.prompt: The senior board directors stand and applaud, nominating you and Adrian as Co-Chairs:

options.label: Accept Co-Chair beside Adrian
options.player_reply_text: Together we’ll take Cross Holdings to new heights.

options.label: Launch a hospital fund in your mom’s name
options.player_reply_text: First motion: a free children’s hospital in my mother’s honor.

nodes.text: 12-0 unanimous vote! Welcome to the top of Cross Holdings, Co-Chairwoman Camille.
You just made an old surgeon tear up—I would be honored to lead the pediatric wing named after your mother!
Every ghost from our past is finally put to rest. Now we owe ourselves a real honeymoon—with working brakes this time.
Deal. No more comas, no more conspiracies—just us.

nodes.headline: One Year Later
nodes.teaser_text: A year later under the sunlit conservatory glass, a second diamond band seals the ultimate rebirth triumph.

nodes.text: 09:30 AM · One Year Later. Sunlit Conservatory Terrace. White roses bloom around the marble fountain as Cross Holdings celebrates a record year.
Happy First Anniversary, you two! Just cut the ribbon on your mother’s Children’s Hospital wing—over 500 families already registered for free care!

nodes.transcript: [soft laugh beside you] "And look who just sent a handwritten letter from prison—Bianca says she’s finishing her accounting degree inside and finally understands what family means."

nodes.text: Everyone got the exact ending they earned. And we got a lifetime nobody can ever steal again.

nodes.prompt: Adrian opens a velvet ring box holding a second eternity diamond band:

options.label: Hold out your hand & smile through tears
options.player_reply_text: One band for the life we survived, one for forever.

options.label: Whisper "Wake up for me in every life"
options.player_reply_text: Promise you’ll wake up for me in every lifetime.

nodes.text: Forever looks even brighter on your hand, my true bride.
Every single lifetime, Camille—I will always find my way back to your hand.
Golden sunlight pours through the conservatory dome as petals drift over the two rings shining side by side on your hand.
No longer a substitute. Never again a shadow. This crown—and this love—are mine.

nodes.headline: Series Finale · Eternal Crown
nodes.teaser_text: From a betrayed substitute bride to Co-Chairwoman of a billion-dollar empire—you rewrote fate and won forever.
